narrative.summary: eVaultFactory.upgradeAdmin() is a Governor whose only admin is a 4-day TimelockController: a 4-of-8 DAO Safe is the sole proposer and anyone can execute once the delay passes, so no on-chain token vote is in the path. The delay has one bypass: PAUSE_GUARDIAN_ROLE, held by a 2-of-6 Labs Safe and two bare EOAs, can put every upgradeable vault into read-only mode instantly.
narrative.tag: cross-exposure: 80, same 8 DAO signers as Plasma
narrative.detail: Every vault this factory has deployed is flagged upgradeable, so its implementation reaches all of them. The DAO Safe’s 8 signers are identical to Euler’s DAO Safe on Plasma at a different Safe address. The 2-of-3 Security Council Safe holds only CANCELLER_ROLE on the factory timelock, and no role on the factory Governor, the emergency governor or either emergency timelock. The same two bare EOAs hold PAUSE_GUARDIAN_ROLE on Plasma’s Euler Governor too.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
